name: cinefile
description: A self-hosted web application for cataloging and displaying physical video media collections

scripts.build:all: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd .. && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json
scripts.desktop:start: npm run build:all && npm run desktop:rebuild && npx electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build:all && npm run desktop:rebuild && npx electron-builder --dir
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:all && npm run desktop:rebuild && npx electron-builder --publish never
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
